TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: ECS Fargate service for the RAG rulebook staging app.

Parameters:
  FoundationStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: rag-rulebook-staging-foundation
  ClusterArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:ecs:eu-west-1:337159794548:cluster/kanbien-staging
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: rag-rulebook-staging
  ImageUri:
    Type: String
    Description: Immutable image URI using repository@sha256:digest.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Default: "256"
  Memory:
    Type: String
    Default: "512"

Resources:
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Ref ServiceName
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      ExecutionRoleArn:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-TaskExecutionRoleArn
      TaskRoleArn:
        Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-TaskRoleArn
      RuntimePlatform:
        CpuArchitecture: X86_64
        OperatingSystemFamily: LINUX
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: rag-rulebook
          Image: !Ref ImageUri
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 3000
              Protocol: tcp
          Environment:
            - Name: HOST
              Value: 0.0.0.0
            - Name: PORT
              Value: "3000"
            - Name: RAG_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK
              Value: "1"
            - Name: RAG_REPO_ROOT
              Value: /app
            - Name: RAG_RUNTIME_DIR
              Value: /app/.cache/02.rag-rulebook
            - Name: NODE_ENV
              Value: production
          Secrets:
            - Name: RAG_SERVICE_TOKEN
              ValueFrom:
                Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-ServiceTokenSecretArn
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group:
                Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-LogGroupName
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: rag-rulebook
          HealthCheck:
            Command:
              - CMD-SHELL
              - node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"
            Interval: 30
            Timeout: 5
            Retries: 3
            StartPeriod: 30

  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ClusterArn
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      EnableExecuteCommand: false
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-ServiceSecurityGroupId
          Subnets: !Split
            - ","
            - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-PublicSubnetIdsCsv
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: rag-rulebook
          ContainerPort: 3000
          TargetGroupArn:
            Fn::ImportValue: !Sub ${FoundationStackName}-TargetGroupArn
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition

Outputs:
  ServiceArn:
    Value: !Ref Service
  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition
